title: Diagrams on demand, right from chat

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You're in your editor, thinking about how a system fits together. What if you just asked for the diagram, and it appeared?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That would beat dragging boxes around.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That's uml-mcp, an open-source server Antoine built for the Model Context Protocol, or M C P. It turns a plain-language request, or diagram code you already wrote, into Mermaid, PlantUML or Kroki diagrams.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: What does M C P do here?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Think of it as a universal plug. It lets an AI assistant call tools, so the assistant can say, make me a sequence diagram, and uml-mcp does the drawing.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: In Cursor, as M C P tools, or in ChatGPT through a custom GPT. There's also a hosted version you can try.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The generate U M L tool and related ones cover sequence, class, flow and deployment sketches. Three render backends mean you can pick the engine that suits you.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Anything cool about how it's used?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Antoine uses it across his own blog, for the inline diagrams in his posts.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Clone the repository and follow the README for the Python setup and the Cursor config. It grew out of his earlier ChatGPT plugin for diagrams.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The project page has the links and the blog write-up.
